    <h1>Star Wars: The Old Republic setup</h1>

<main class="doc guide">
<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
The SWTOR module brings Operation sign-ups by Combat Style and Discipline, characters with their server, the Operations as ready-made templates, Conquest nights and loot for your guild. Finish [**Setting up Alagos**](/guides/setting-up/) first.

## 1. Switch it on

Run `/guild-settings modules` and press **Switch on** beside **Star Wars: The Old Republic**. Its tab appears in `/guild-settings show`.

## 2. Characters

Your members add their own characters, main and alts: the name, the **server** (Star Forge, Satele Shan, Darth Malgus, Tulak Hord, Leviathan), the **Combat Style** (Sentinel, Marauder, Sorcerer and so on: each faction's name is its own), then the **Discipline** and an off-Discipline from a menu that shows only that style's three. Officers can still add or fix anyone's. To change who adds characters, press **👤 Who adds characters** on the game's tab.

## 3. Operations

Press **New event** and pick a template by name, such as **Children of Nul (8)** or **R-4 Anomaly (16)**:

- **8 players:** 2 tanks, 2 healers, 4 damage.
- **16 players:** 2 tanks, 4 healers, 10 damage.

Change the slots on any event. Flashpoint nights and Conquest pushes have templates too. Running an Operation without a template? Make your own in **📋 Event templates**; every Operation is in the game's list.

## 4. Sign-ups

Members press the role they want. Alagos picks their Discipline for it: their main Discipline first, then their off-Discipline, then the style's other one, on their main character first and then their alts. The post shows **Kallig · Corruption Sorcerer**.

## 5. Coming from Raid-Helper

**📥 Import from Raid-Helper** on the **Features & limits** tab takes Raid-Helper's SWTOR events. Raid-Helper records a Combat Style and a role, not a Discipline, so Alagos fills in the Discipline where only one of the style's plays that role (a healing Sorcerer is Corruption); damage sign-ups come in with the style and role.

## 6. Game Update 8.0

Alagos is ready for **Masters of the Force**. The Disciplines are those before 8.0: if 8.0 renames one or changes a role, it is corrected in the game's list, and nothing you have set up changes.
